image_description: A grey and silver minibus parked on an asphalt surface with trees in the background. The vehicle features a boxy body, large side windows, a sliding door, and standard van wheels.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus (likely a Fiat Ducato or similar chassis). It is clearly distinct from a full-size transit bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, and there is a continuous row of tinted passenger windows along the side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width, and a sliding entrance door is clearly visible behind the front wheel arch.
A sliding door track and handle mechanism are visible on the side of the vehicle.
The front hood/bonnet structure indicates a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is not visible in this three-quarter front view.

The window configuration suggests seating capacity consistent with the 4-10 passenger range.
